test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the correct statement.

options.text: Panchachuli peak is the highest peak in the Indian Himalayas.
Dhupgarh is the highest peak of the Satpura Range.
Mahendragiri mountain is the highest peak of the Satpura Range.
Dhupgarh is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghat.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhupgarh is the highest peak of the Satpura Range.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dhupgarh** is the highest peak of the Satpura Range.
 
• Located in **Madhya Pradesh**, India.
 
• The peak reaches an elevation of **1,350 meters (4,429 feet)** above sea level.
 
• Dhupgarh is situated near the popular hill station of **Pachmarhi**.
 
• It offers panoramic views of the surrounding **Satpura hills and valleys**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satpura Range:**

 
 
• A range of hills in central India, stretching through Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It forms the watershed between the Narmada and Tapti rivers.
 
• Known for its rich biodiversity, including various flora and fauna.
 
• The range is home to several national parks, including Satpura National Park and Pench National Park.
 
 
 
• **Panchachuli Peaks:**
 
 
• A group of five snow-capped Himalayan peaks located in the Pithoragarh district of Uttarakhand, India.
 
• The highest of these peaks stands at an elevation of about 6,904 meters (22,651 feet).
 
• Popular among mountaineers and trekkers for their challenging trails and breathtaking views.
 
 
 
• **Mahendragiri:**
 
 
• A mountain peak in the Eastern Ghats, located in the Gajapati district of Odisha, India.
 
• It is the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats of Odisha, with an elevation of 1,501 meters (4,925 feet).
 
• Known for its mythological significance and scenic beauty.
 
 
 
• **Eastern Ghats:**
 
 
• A range of mountains along India's eastern coast, extending from West Bengal to Tamil Nadu.
 
• Lower in elevation compared to the Western Ghats, with an average height of about 600 meters (2,000 feet).
 
• Comprises several distinct hill ranges, including the Nallamala, Velikonda, Palakonda, and Seshachalam hills.
